title: Tail a log file
hints: collections.deque(maxlen=n) keeps only the last n items you append; older ones fall off the front automatically.
Feed the file object straight in: deque(f, maxlen=n). Iterating a file yields lines with their newline attached.
Watch n == 0: deque(maxlen=0) is always empty, but check the ValueError case for negatives before opening the file.
